knock-balls.title: Knock Balls: Free Online Physics Puzzle Game
knock-balls.slogan: Challenge your physics skills and strategy in Knock Balls!
knock-balls.description: Knock Balls is an engaging physics puzzle game where you throw balls to collapse structures. Be strategic and avoid exceeding the allowed limit! Each saved ball doubles in value for the next level, enhancing your gameplay. Enjoy easy-to-learn controls, stunning visuals, and addictive mechanics. Play Knock Balls now and test your precision!
